instruction: Please extract the GPT-4 model performance data from "~/Documents/awesome-desktop/expe-results.xlsx" along with column headers, and insert it as a table under the "Main Results" section of my current report.

The getter extracts both table data and document structure to verify placement. Verified by reading Excel file which has these exact headers in row 1 and GPT-4 data in row 2.
